from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.STAR_BATTLE_DEBATE_PROMPT] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.STAR_BATTLE_DEBATE_AGG_PROMPT,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        draft = await debate(problem)
        finalizer = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_rounds=1,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.STAR_BATTLE_FORMAT_PROMPT],
        )
        solution = await finalizer(draft["response"] + "\n\nOriginal Puzzle:\n" + problem)
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

Rules to satisfy:
- Place stars only on original '.' cells; never alter any 'X'.
- Final board must have EXACTLY one '*' in each row and EXACTLY one '*' in each column.

- If a placement creates a contradiction, backtrack.

- First infer a candidate set of star coordinates as (row, col), 1-indexed.
- Check all pairwise diagonal adjacencies explicitly.
- Check row counts and column counts explicitly.
- If other proposals in {all_proposals} reveal a contradiction in your current idea, revise it.
- Be very careful: many failures come from diagonal adjacency or malformed board dimensions.

Final Board:
<begin_board>
[board]
<end_board>

Puzzle:
{problem}

Round: {round}
Agent: {agent_id}
